train.note: V023 only adds distinguishable pairs merged into the V022 train set (6252 endpoints); full mode generates this count, smoke uses --n-pairs to override

validation_iid.note: This batch is not generated; the seeds are registered only to prevent overlap

test_locked.note: test_locked stays frozen (V022 6258 endpoints); the seeds are registered only to prevent overlap

deep_targeting.note: Deep = support centroid depth >=600 m (V025 convention: depth=extent_z-z_geom); 10% targeted generation for ordinary samples and A prototypes (decided by the author on 2026-09-12); (B_structural,large) deep structures are infeasible and are repaired by mechanism exchange following the DeepVal method

ambiguity.reference_sigma_provenance: V022 pre-registered sigma ([0.85,0.62,1.4,0.85,1.4,1.48] E, component-wise medians of V018 ordinary at 25 dB) halved; must match noise.base_component_sigma_eotvos component by component (whitening sigma = physical noise-adding sigma)
ambiguity.response_group_note: V023 sets no spin1/spin2/mixed quota (under the distinguishable-pair semantics the differences are large in all components); response_group is only labelled and recorded from the actual dominance ratio
ambiguity.pair_geometry_mode_note: The smoke stage only builds same-support pairs (Jaccard=1); variable support (Jaccard<=0.9 and symmetric difference >=8%) is left for evaluation and implementation before the full run
ambiguity.direction_note: Coarse-grid standard normal -> trilinear upsampling to 16x32x32 -> kernel-3 avg_pool smoothing -> zero-mass on the support (subtract the fraction-weighted mean; redistribution does not change total mass) -> peak normalization within the support (|m|<=1) -> direction = fraction * m; the V022 Adam multi-start optimization is no longer used
ambiguity.proposal_jitter_note: Each proposal perturbs base_contrast/amplitude by U(1-j,1+j) around the task-card value and then clips back into the interval, equivalent to the amplitude perturbation during scale search

noise.base_sigma_note: All V022 sigmas halved; observation = clean + iid N(0,1) * sigma * amplitude; the V022 smooth/stripe/common-mode three-mode mixture is dropped
noise.frozen_seed_note: The smoke frozen seed 2026091214 is used only for smoke self-check products and never enters any training/evaluation pipeline
